body:

Restore jointly recoverable source partners before handoffs destroy required reads, transport exact target residuals through the target precondition, and derive inverse cleanup from the changed word. Helpers fall from 430 to 422 per call. Both orientations are checked on all 646 independent inputs; all 78 cold endpoints and private cleanup buffers remain charged. The diagonal call order and literal fill admit all 281,052 whole-helper roles.

The full global paid profile is `{1:1599730, 2:420912, 3:219782, 4:78588, 5:17756, 7:5328, 8:114, 16:172, 32:3, 48:26488}`. There are 74 replicas, 666 calls, dimension 73, live stock 66304, physical stock 66814, deficit 23680, and charged prefix reserve 2048 bits. The exact hosted rank mass is 4,816,512. The supplier endpoint is 0.001713737921547504346752; exact outer refinement establishes the final claim.

This is a conditional finite construction with exact outer arithmetic. Inherited all-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-source, realization, precision/exact-recovery, analytic, and other multiplication-theorem obligations remain. No independent human review or complete multiplication theorem is claimed. The selected frontier is unchanged.
